Neuro Support Checker

Support for autism, ADHD, dyslexia, learning disability, Down syndrome, brain injury and more, across the UK.

Is it still running?

Before you signpost someone, check the organisation's website. It takes a few seconds.

I know its charity number (optional)

Browse the directory

897 UK organisations, checked every 1 to 3 days (daily if anything looks wrong). Last check: 18 Oct 2026. The score (out of 100) shows how sure we are each one is still running.

Not sure where to start?

Answer 3 quick questions by tapping a button.

Your postcode is only used to find your council area and work out distances. It is not stored. Nothing is hidden: organisations are sorted by how sure we are they serve your area.
